issue_context.title: Support set audit log related params
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request
Now we can set audit log max rotation size by log.file.max-size, but it will change all tidb logs.

Try add audit log related params to control the audit log max rotation size and so on.
comments: Added in audit plugin, close this issue

review_comments:
I'm not sure if this is good to add those params in Log sturct. 
Or I can have a new type called AuditLog which includes `Filename`, `Level` and so on. @bb7133
BTW, it's same as `SlowQueryFile` and `SlowThreshold`. I'm not sure which one is better.
